headline: Broad-based record growth across both segments
summary_short: HEICO's Q2 FY2026 net sales rose 25.3% y/y and 16.7% q/q to a record $1,376M, with operating income up 41.2% y/y to $350M and net income attributable to HEICO up 49.1% y/y to $234M ($1.66 diluted EPS).
summary_long: Net sales hit a record $1,376M, up 25.3% y/y (FSG +21% on 19% organic growth, ETG +34% on 17% organic growth plus recent acquisitions). Gross margin expanded to 41.4% from 39.9% on favorable mix at both segments. Operating income rose 41.2% y/y to $350M as SG&A fell to 15.9% of sales from 17.3% on cost leverage from the sales growth. Net income attributable to HEICO rose 49.1% y/y to $234M ($1.66 diluted EPS). Total debt rose to $2,587M from $2,168M at fiscal year-end, funding $821M of H1 acquisitions; cash was $210M. Management now estimates fiscal 2026 capex at $85-95M; no formal revenue or EPS guidance is given.

drivers.explanation: FSG net sales +21% (19% organic plus $17.4M from FY2026 acquisitions) on demand for aftermarket parts, specialty products, and repair/overhaul; ETG net sales +34% (17% organic plus $58.3M acquisitions) on demand for defense, aerospace, and other electronics.

Consolidated gross margin rose to 41.4% from 39.9%, principally a 2.7pt margin gain at ETG (favorable aerospace product mix on higher sales) plus a 0.8pt gain at FSG (favorable aftermarket-parts mix).

FSG operating income +31%, ETG +56%, both reflecting the sales growth and SG&A efficiencies from that growth; SG&A fell to 15.9% of sales from 17.3% and the FSG gain also reflects its improved gross margin.
Tracks the higher consolidated operating income; the effective tax rate was little changed at 21.2% vs 21.0% a year ago, so it was not a driver.

Management's outlook expects continued net-sales growth at both segments for the rest of fiscal 2026 on underlying demand and recent acquisitions, alongside ongoing evaluation of further acquisition opportunities.
